dedupe_keys.name: gridcerf china power plant siting suitability

description: The GRIDCERF-China research team publishes geospatial suitability layers for selecting power-plant locations in mainland China. The Figshare deposit covers seven generation technologies and packages the layers as GeoTIFF rasters in a public ZIP archive. Access is free under CC BY 4.0. The product extends the siting-data purpose represented by the United States data-gridcerf record to a different country. It can supply spatial constraints for capacity-expansion and siting simulations using model-pypsa or other planning tools. A caveat is that a suitability classification does not establish land permission, project economics or engineering feasibility at a particular site. The repository metadata do not independently list every threshold or technology configuration. Those details and raster contents require checking against package documentation before operational use; no archive was downloaded.
